dedupe_keys.name: sheerm portugal household energy weather and prices

description: The SHEERM research team publishes energy observations and supporting calculations for thirteen households in Portugal. Coverage combines fifteen-minute electricity consumption, weather, electricity prices, household metadata and photovoltaic-generation estimates, with analysis and preparation notebooks. Raw consumption and versions with filled gaps are provided separately. The public Zenodo files are free under CC BY 4.0. These series can drive household demand-response and distributed-energy simulations using model-energyplus or model-pypsa. A caveat is that filled consumption is estimated and photovoltaic output is calculated, not measured. The inspected photovoltaic notebook uses a simplified irradiance and temperature formula; its angle conventions and array handling require checking before reproduction. Weather represents grid cells, not roof sensors. The metadata and small calculation notebook were read without downloading the household observations.
